description: This file defines a singleton object SparkSQLEnv that manages Spark SQL environment initialization and shutdown, including SparkSession and SparkContext setup, with integration for Hive support.

classes.name: SparkSQLEnv
classes.description: A singleton object managing Spark SQL environment setup and teardown, including SparkSession and SparkContext initialization, with Hive support.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes SparkSession and SparkContext, configures Hive support if applicable, and sets up external catalog integration.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down SparkContext and resets SparkSession and SparkContext references.
